SleepCheck is more than a sleep or snore recorder, it assesses your risk of obstructive sleep apnoea by analysing your breathing and snoring sounds while you sleep. 

**Why should I take the test?**
Obstructive sleep apnoea (or apnea) is a serious medical condition that can have a major impact on your life. If you have obstructive sleep apnoea, air stops flowing to your lungs for ten seconds or longer during sleep. In some cases, this can happen more than 30 times per hour all night. 

**How the SleepCheck app works**
SleepCheck records your breathing and snoring sounds while you sleep. SleepCheck then uses clinically validated machine-learning algorithms to assess your risk of obstructive sleep apnoea.

1.	Make sure you are the only person sleeping in the room
2.	Answer a few questions on your age, gender and neck size

NEWS2 Calculator is designed to make it easier for healthcare professionals to calculate NEWS or NEWS2 scores during the assessment of acute illnesses in patients.

The NEWS and NEWS2 are scoring systems which use six physiological parameters, which are recorded in routine practice, to give an aggregate score which can be used to determine the best response for acutely ill patients. The six parameters are:
- Respiratory rate
- Oxygen saturation
- Systolic blood pressure
- Pulse rate
- Level of consciousness
- Temperature

A score is allocated to each parameter during measurement. A larger score means the parameter varies more from normal levels.

NEWS2 Calculator has options to colour code the controls based on their value (for example, when changing the value of a parameter which would give a score of 3, the control turns red).
